name: zclass_camera_find_convex_hull_xz
description: zClass_Camera::FindConvexHullXZ builds an in-place XZ hull chain using the recovered angle scan.
known_limits: Binary Ninja keeps a limited reconstruction marker because in-place zVec3 stride arithmetic and x87 angle comparisons still leave HLIL artifacts.
No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded for this camera geometry helper; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent camera source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x44c230 validates the highest-Z start selection with the 0.1 tolerance, sentinel copy at points[count], in-place swaps, FastAngleXZ scan, fallback zError report path, and hull count return.
The native camera convex-hull smoke verifies a square with an interior point returns the recovered in-place angle-scan hull chain.
